input.summary: Learn the banana flippers, use the right flipper for the left drop bank, build the printed 20,000 bonus and 5x Bonus X, then collect a built right bullseye and protect the drain bonus.

quickInfo.name: Base Bonus
quickInfo.summary: Lanes and target banks add 2,000 until the printed ladder reaches 20,000.

quickInfo.name: Bonus X
quickInfo.summary: Each D-I-S-C-O completion advances the multiplier through 2x, 3x, and 5x.

quickInfo.name: Spot Bonus X
quickInfo.summary: The lit upper-left horseshoe advances Bonus X without clearing the current D-I-S-C-O letters.

quickInfo.name: Right Bullseye
quickInfo.summary: Each A-B completion raises the collect from 5,000 to a 30,000 maximum.

steps.text: Plunge for the lit A or B lane. Watch one complete top exit before you repeat the plunge.
Test one normal forehand and one early Backhand before you choose a target route.
modeNotes: Banana flippers: The curved bats change the normal release point, so a forehand usually needs a later release.

steps.text: Transfer to the right flipper when the feed permits it. Use that flipper for the left three-drop bank.
Build Base Bonus with A-B lanes, return lanes, the left drop bank, and safe upper targets.
modeNotes: Base Bonus: Each advance adds 2,000. The printed ladder starts at 2,000 and ends at 20,000.
Confirm 20,000 maximum Base Bonus, 5x Bonus X, bullseye ladder and reset, plus carried A-B, D-I-S-C-O, and bullseye progress.

steps.text: Spell D-I-S-C-O. Use a lit Spot Bonus X horseshoe when the horseshoe feed is safe.
modeNotes: Bonus X: A D-I-S-C-O completion advances 2x, 3x, then 5x.
Spot Bonus X: The lit horseshoe advances the multiplier without clearing D-I-S-C-O progress.

steps.text: Prefer the left drop bank to the two center drops. Both advance bonus, but the center rebound is less controlled.
Complete A-B until the far-right bullseye is worth at least 20,000. Shoot it only from control.
modeNotes: Right Bullseye: A-B raises the value through 5,000, 10,000, 15,000, 20,000, and 30,000; the collect resets it to 5,000.

steps.text: Protect the 5x drain bonus when the opponent's score does not require another rebound target.

fallback.title: Far-left lane and bonus
fallback.when: Use this when both drop banks reject toward the drain.

steps.text: Control the ball on the right flipper.
Shoot the far-left side lane for 5,000 and the needed A or B letter.
Use return lanes and incidental targets to build Base Bonus.
Take Spot Bonus X only when the upper-left horseshoe returns safely.
Drain safely with the built bonus instead of forcing a standup.

alternatives.title: Built right bullseye
alternatives.when: Use this when the far-left lane and right bullseye are repeatable.

steps.text: Complete A-B with top lanes, return lanes, or the far-left lane.
Complete A-B again until the bullseye reaches 20,000 or 30,000.
Trap on the left flipper and shoot the far-right bullseye.
Repeat only after the value rebuilds.

alternatives.title: F-E-V-E-R awards
alternatives.when: Use this only when Extra Ball or Special has a useful tournament award.

steps.text: Complete F-E-V-E-R twice to light Extra Ball at the horseshoe.
A third completion alternates Special between the outlanes.
Stop this route when those awards give no tournament points.
Use A-B lanes, return lanes, the left drop bank, and safe upper targets until Base Bonus reaches the printed 20,000 maximum.
Spell D-I-S-C-O until 5x is lit.
Complete A-B until the far-right bullseye reaches 30,000.
Collect the bullseye and protect the 100,000 drain bonus.

techniques.name: Banana-flipper calibration
techniques.instruction: Use low-value shots to learn the curved flippers before you aim at a valuable target.

techniques.name: Right-flipper route
techniques.instruction: Transfer to the right flipper and use it for the left bank and upper-left D-I-S-C-O target.

techniques.name: Backhand
techniques.instruction: Backhand a low-value same-side shot while calibrating the banana flippers before using that release on a scoring target.

techniques.name: Tap pass
techniques.instruction: Attempt a Tap pass only after testing the curved flipper's response on a low-value ball position.

techniques.name: Post pass
techniques.instruction: Attempt a Post pass only after confirming that the banana flipper can move the ball across without opening a center drain.

cautions.issue: Most target shots have strong rebound risk.
cautions.response: Use the left drop bank instead of the center drops and shoot standups only from control.

cautions.issue: A slow counterclockwise horseshoe exit can feed the center drain.
cautions.response: Nudge before the ball leaves the upper-left horseshoe.

cautions.issue: Banana flippers make Tap passes and Post passes less reliable.
cautions.response: Do not use an untested transfer on a tournament ball.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm Williams Disco Fever, ball count, Extra Ball and Special conversion, replay settings, tilt, and tournament scoring.
Confirm 20,000 maximum Base Bonus, 5x Bonus X, bullseye ladder and reset, plus carried A-B, D-I-S-C-O, and bullseye progress.
Test both banana flippers, left and center drop rebounds, upper-left horseshoe exit, far-right bullseye, lanes, and top exits before choosing the route.

playfieldReferences.label: Spinner
playfieldReferences.description: Repeatable scoring shot used in the main route.
playfieldReferences.context: Repeatable scoring shot used in the main route.

playfieldReferences.label: Drop-target bank
playfieldReferences.description: Bank used to qualify the collect.
playfieldReferences.context: Bank used to qualify the collect.

input.simpleOverview: Disco Fever is a bonus-and-bullseye game played with banana flippers. Use the right flipper for the left drop bank, complete D-I-S-C-O for Bonus X, repeat A-B to raise the far-right bullseye, then collect it from control and protect the multiplied drain bonus.
input.overview: Disco Fever is a bonus-and-bullseye game played with banana flippers. Learn the banana-flipper angles, favor the left bank over the dangerous center drops, reach 5x and 20,000 base, then complete A-B until the far-right bullseye is worth 30,000 and shoot it from control.
machineSetup: Confirm Williams Disco Fever, ball count, Extra Ball and Special conversion, replay settings, tilt, and tournament scoring.
Test both banana flippers, left and center drop rebounds, upper-left horseshoe exit, far-right bullseye, lanes, and top exits before choosing the route.
